annotations.title: Home loan: rates, borrowing capacity, payments

description: France's home-loan rates this month (L'Observatoire Crédit Logement/CSA, per 15, 20 and 25 years, excluding insurance) and, as asked: what a household can borrow (income_monthly: payments, insurance included, at most 35 % of net income less its other loans, the HCSF rule), and the budget it buys with its down payment once the purchase costs are paid; what a price (or a loan amount, loan) costs a month over each length, the income it needs at 35 % and the debt ratio it makes, with a PTZ beside the bank loan (ptz, at 0 %); a rate a bank offered (offered_rate, offered_years: a nominal rate excluding insurance, not a TAEG) against the market's for that length, its monthly payment and what the difference costs over the loan; a bridge loan on the home being sold (bridge_value): its amount and monthly interest. Purchase costs: notary, guarantee and fees, 8 % of the price for a resale, 3 % for a new home (new_build), unless purchase_costs is given (0 when the developer pays them; for a plot and a build contract, about 8 % of the plot only). Insurance: 0.30 % of the loan a year unless insurance_rate says otherwise.

bridge_months.description: With bridge_value: months until the sale (default 12, at most 24).

bridge_owed.description: With bridge_value: what is still owed on that home.

bridge_rate.description: With bridge_value: the bank's rate for it (default the 15-year rate plus half a point).

bridge_share.description: With bridge_value: the share of its value lent (default 0.7).

bridge_value.description: A bridge loan (prêt relais): the value of the home being sold, in euros.

debts_monthly.description: Monthly payments of the household's other loans (car, consumer), in euros; default 0.

down_payment.description: Cash put in (apport), in euros; default 0.

income_monthly.description: The household's net monthly income (before income tax), in euros.

insurance_rate.description: Borrower insurance a year as a share of the loan (0.003 for 0.30 %).

loan.description: The bank loan's amount, in euros, when known (instead of working it out from price).

new_build.description: A new home (VEFA): reduced notary fees.

offered_rate.description: A rate a bank offered, nominal, excluding insurance (0.039 or 3.9 for 3.90 %); a TAEG is some 0.3 to 0.5 point above it.

offered_years.description: The length of the offered loan in years (default 25).

price.description: A price to finance, in euros.

ptz.description: A zero-rate loan (PTZ) beside the bank's, in euros (the ptz tool works it out).

ptz_tranche.description: With ptz: its income tranche (1 to 4, from the ptz tool), for its deferral and repayment.

purchase_costs.description: Purchase costs as a share of the price (0.08 for 8 %; 0 when the developer pays them), instead of the default.
